generate_mutator_documentation: run the script to generate a mutators_list.inc documentation file for all registered ParlAI mutators
build_argparse_table: build a reStructuredText table of command-line arguments and descriptions for a given mutator class
display_data_with_mutator: run DisplayData with a specific mutator to show mutated output for the convai2:sample task
setup_mutator_registry: build the mutator registry from parlai.core.mutators to list all available mutator classes
capture_display_output: capture the stdout output of DisplayData.main using the capture_output context manager
